description: This file declares the TpmGatekeeper class, which is a specialized implementation of the GateKeeper interface for TPM-based security operations. It includes method declarations for cryptographic operations, failure record management, and hardware backing status, and references external TPM and storage components.

classes.name: TpmGatekeeper
classes.description: A class implementing TPM-based gatekeeper functionalities, including cryptographic operations, failure record management, and hardware backing status, utilizing TPM resource management and secure storage.

methods.name: TpmGatekeeper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TpmGatekeeper with TPM resource manager and storage references.

methods.name: ComputePasswordSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature over the password using a specified key and salt.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Fills the provided buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Computes a cryptographic signature over a message with a given key.

methods.name: GetMillisecondsSinceBoot
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed since system boot.

methods.name: GetFailureRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the failure record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: ClearFailureRecord
methods.description: Clears the failure record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: WriteFailureRecord
methods.description: Writes a failure record for a user.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Indicates whether the hardware is backed by TPM.
